ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized, high-intensity white field spanning both lobes; thick low-intensity black perimeter band along the trailing edge and distal tips; scattered low-intensity focal spots (mottling) concentrated near the leading edges and within the right lobe interior.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 55-65 degrees and a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude serrations across the trailing edge; significant high-amplitude, irregular jaggedness and pixel-level erosion at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating at the notch and sweeping upward towards the tips; leading edges exhibit a broad, smooth convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, roughly circular pixel clusters present at both distal tips, appearing as dark spots on white or eroded white texture on dark margins; small dark circular clusters on the lower-left interior lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal low-intensity linear marks (rake marks) visible across the white field of both lobes, particularly prominent on the mid-left lobe and near the notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive physical erosion and irregular scarring at both lobe tips; distinct parallel rake marks across the ventral pigment.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark vertical marking situated directly below the median notch apex.
